modules.title: Introduction to Wakilin Suna (Pronouns)
modules.html:
Personal, possessive and demonstrative pronouns in Hausa. This section covers introduction to wakilin suna (pronouns).

Key points

  • Menene 'Wakilin suna na mallaka' (Possessive Pronoun) — Nawa.
  • Wanne ne 'wakilin suna' (pronoun) na nuni na kusa — Wannan.
  • Menene 'Wakilin Suna' — Pronoun.
  • Wane wakilin suna ne ake amfani da shi ga mutum na uku (namiji) — Ya.
  • A cikin 'Yara suna wasa', wace kalma ce aikatau — Wasa.

Worked examples

Q: Menene 'Wakilin suna na mallaka' (Possessive Pronoun)?
A: Nawa — 'Nawa' means 'mine', indicating possession.

Q: Wanne ne 'wakilin suna' (pronoun) na nuni na kusa?
A: Wannan — 'Wannan' (this) is used to point at items that are close to the speaker.

examples.q: Wanne ne 'wakilin suna' (pronoun) na nuni na kusa?

quiz.q: Menene 'Wakilin suna na mallaka' (Possessive Pronoun)?
Wanne ne 'wakilin suna' (pronoun) na nuni na kusa?
quiz.solution: 'Wannan' (this) is used to point at items that are close to the speaker.

quiz.q: Menene 'Wakilin Suna'?
Wane wakilin suna ne ake amfani da shi ga mutum na uku (namiji)?
A cikin 'Yara suna wasa', wace kalma ce aikatau?
Danladi suna ne na wanda aka haifa ranar:
Wace sana'a ce 'Saka'?
quiz.solution: 'Saka' refers to the traditional craft of weaving clothes.

quiz.q: Wanne ne siffa (Adjective) na launi (color)?
quiz.solution: 'Baki' means black, which is a color adjective.

quiz.q: Wanne ne sunan azuzuwan Hausa?
quiz.solution: Daidaitacciyar Hausa refers to the standard academic form of the language.

quiz.q: Mene ne kalmar 'Bayanau' (Adverb)?
quiz.solution: An adverb (Bayanau) is a word that modifies or describes a verb (fi'ili).

quiz.q: Wanne ne kalmar nuni na nesa (distant demonstrative)?
quiz.solution: 'Wancan' (that) refers to items far from the speaker.

quiz.q: A ina ake sana'ar 'Saka'?
quiz.solution: The weaving house or center is called 'Masaka'.

quiz.q: Babban birnin Najeriya:
Kalmar 'Zo':
Menene 'Eye'?
Abincin Hausawa:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Tuwo da Miya.

quiz.q: Idan ana 'Sallah', ina ake kallo?

Wane harafi ne ke farawa da kalmar 'Ɗalibi'?

quiz.q: Menene jam'in 'Doki'?
Ana yin Sallah sau nawa a rana?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Sau biyar.

quiz.q: Jam'in 'Mota' shi ne:
Mene ne 'Milk' da Hausa?
